FORJA.System.title: FORJA RPG
FORJA.Actor.Name: Character name
FORJA.Item.EfecteAjuda: Advanced field: modifies one of the actor's derived stats. Leave it blank if the trait is purely descriptive.
FORJA.Item.EfecteJSONInvalid: The "Effect" field is not valid JSON: the change was not saved.
FORJA.Combat.PocaPenetracio: Low penetration (shotgun): rigid armor protects double ({proteccio}).
FORJA.Combat.PifiaEsquivarDany: Botch while dodging: +{valor} damage if the attack hits
FORJA.Combat.PifiaEsquivarDanyAplicat: {nom} botched the dodge and put themselves in the attack's path: +{valor} damage.
FORJA.Combat.RetardBarallarseDesc: Extra latency, up to {max} (the brawling level): each added tick gives +1 die to the attack.
FORJA.Combat.Blocar.Limit: The bonus cannot exceed natural damage reduction (it doubles it at most). Against weapon attacks you cannot block with your body.
FORJA.Curacio.HabilitatInsuficient: {nom} cannot perform {tipus}: {hab} {minim} or higher is required.
FORJA.Curacio.NivellMinim: {hab} {minim} or higher is required for this treatment.
FORJA.Curacio.AutotractamentDJ: {nom} cannot treat themselves without the GM's approval: the GM must do it.
FORJA.Curacio.AutotractamentAvis: Treating yourself can only be done in extreme cases and with the GM's approval: the GM must trigger the action.
FORJA.Item.PropietatsAjuda: Comma-separated. Recognized: escut (block with melee weapons), escopeta (low penetration).
FORJA.PNJ.DefensaAutomaticaAjuda: How this NPC defends when attacked. “Ask the GM” opens a dialog for the GM; the others are applied without asking (useful for minions).
FORJA.PNJ.ModeDefensa.millor: Best active (if it has a reaction)
FORJA.Combat.EsperantDefensa: Waiting for {nom} to choose how {defensor} defends…
FORJA.Combat.DefensaSenseDecisor: Nobody is connected to decide how {nom} defends: passive defence is used.
FORJA.Combat.DefensaSenseResposta: {nom} did not choose how {defensor} defends in time: passive defence is used.
FORJA.Derivat.MovimentDesc: Distance in metres per turn. Walk = AGI×2 + SIZE − 3; run = AGI×5 + (SIZE − 3)×2; jump = AGI×3 + ⌈(SIZE − 3)/2⌉ (minimum 1).
FORJA.Avis.MecanoideSobrenatural: A Mechanoid cannot have the supernatural trait "{nom}": it is paid for but has no effect (does not grant gifted status, cannot manifest).
FORJA.Avis.PXExcedit: XP spent exceeds available by {valor} points.
FORJA.Millora.TretAfegirDesc: Upon confirmation, the trait catalog will open to choose a positive one.
FORJA.Millora.SenseTretsNegatius: This character has no negative traits.
FORJA.Millora.JaAlMaxim: Already at maximum value: cannot be improved further.
FORJA.Millora.PXInsuficients: Not enough free XP to pay for this improvement.
FORJA.Millora.NomesTretsPositius: With XP you can only acquire positive traits.
FORJA.Millora.NomesTretsNegatius: With XP you can only remove existing negative traits.
FORJA.Concentracio.HintInactiu: Concentrate: +1 die to the next action, but cannot react until it ends or is broken.
FORJA.Concentracio.HintActiu: Concentrating: no reactions. Click to voluntarily break concentration.
FORJA.Artefacte.ProvarPrototipIntro: It is still a prototype: each use requires a roll of the relevant skill against the artifact's cost (diff. {cost}). A botch marks it as broken.
FORJA.Artefacte.PifiaPrototip1: The prototype is ruined: new materials will be needed to rebuild it as a new first prototype (at GM's discretion).
FORJA.Artefacte.PifiaPrototip2: The prototype needs adjustments before it can work again.
FORJA.Artefacte.MarcarProduccioText: The artifact will no longer be a prototype: normal reliability, no test rolls on each use (manual: "once the testing period is over, the device will function normally"). Confirm when you consider the testing period has passed.
FORJA.Artefacte.Reparat: {nom} repaired: it can be used again.
FORJA.Combat.BlocarSenseAccio: {nom} blocks: no roll required — just apply the extra reduction if the attack hits.
FORJA.Combat.SenseObjectiu: No target selected (mark it on the canvas with Target): only the roll will be made, without resolving the attack.
FORJA.Combat.AvancarTemps: Advance the clock to the next occupied tick
FORJA.Combat.AvancarTempsEspera: Some combatants still have to act or declare on this tick
FORJA.Anunci.AvancTics: The active time clock advances {n} ticks
FORJA.Anunci.AvancTic: The active time clock advances {n} tick
FORJA.Combat.ObjectiuNoATocar: {nom} is {distancia} m away, not adjacent: the attacker must close in with this turn's movement (up to {metres} m). If the target moves away out of reach, the action is lost.
FORJA.Combat.ObjectiuDeclaratNoTrobat: The declared target ({nom}) is no longer in the scene: the target marked on the canvas is used instead.
FORJA.Combat.ManiobraIntro: {nom} attacks with Strike. Use a martial arts maneuver?
FORJA.Combat.LlancamentXocMur: {nom} slams into a wall while being thrown.
FORJA.Combat.SelectorCaselesIntro: Click {n} cells on the map to choose the affected area. Click a cell again to deselect it.
FORJA.Combat.CarregaBonus: Charge (2 m or more): +{daus} die to the attack and +{dany} damage if it hits.
FORJA.Moviment.BasicDesc: Up to {metres} m on your turn, in addition to the action.
FORJA.Moviment.RapidDesc: Up to {metres} m on your turn. Cannot be combined with any other action.
FORJA.Moviment.EspecialDesc: Up to {metres} m. Requires a roll (the GM calls for it); +2 latency.
FORJA.Moviment.CarregaDesc: Run up to {metres} m and make a melee attack; +2 latency. If you move 2 m or more: +1 die to the attack and +1 damage if it hits.
FORJA.Moviment.NoEsElTeuTorn: {nom} can only move on their own turn.
FORJA.Moviment.PermisExhaurit: {nom} cannot move that far: {restant} m left out of {permis} m this turn.
FORJA.Moviment.EspaiOcupat: A token cannot end its movement in another token's space.
FORJA.Moviment.SenseTeletransport: Teleport movement is not allowed in combat.
FORJA.Moviment.ResoldreMoviment: {nom} only moves: drag their token on the canvas.
FORJA.Combat.ConsequenciesNoAplicades: Not all effects could be applied to {nom} ({error}). GM: apply them manually from this result.
FORJA.Combat.AvisMoviment: The whole turn is dedicated to moving (running): cannot be combined with any other action. Basic movement while doing something else (e.g. approaching before attacking) does not need to be declared separately.
FORJA.Combat.DefensaDescripcio: Dodge, parry or block (base latency, without attacking)
FORJA.Combat.Defensa.EsquivarDesc: Replaces basic defense (minimum defense+1); full action, you can move.
FORJA.Combat.Defensa.PararDesc: Stops the weapon before impact; sets the attacker's difficulty.
FORJA.Combat.Defensa.BlocarDesc: No roll; you must beat (not just match) basic defense, but it adds endurance (body), melee weapons (shield) or improvised weapons (other objects) to damage reduction.
FORJA.Combat.ReduccioExtra: +{valor} damage reduction if the attack hits
FORJA.Combat.SenseReaccioDisponibleAvis: No reactions available (or concentrating): cannot be chosen.
FORJA.Combat.SenseReaccioDisponible: {nom} has no reactions left: reopen the dialog and choose another defense.
FORJA.Combat.ForaAbast: {nom} is out of weapon range (beyond long/extreme range): move the token if reachable, or consider the action lost.
FORJA.Combat.ForaAbastCosACos: {nom} is not within reach: move the attacker's token next to the target before resolving a melee attack, or consider the action lost.
FORJA.Combat.Defensa.PassivaReaccioDesc: Basic defense, no cost or roll: the attacker needs to equal or surpass it.
FORJA.Combat.Defensa.EsquivarReaccioDesc: AGI + dodge (minimum defense+1): the roll sets the difficulty the attacker must SURPASS (tie = attack fails).
FORJA.Combat.Defensa.PararReaccioDesc: DEX + best available melee skill (minimum defense+1): the roll sets the difficulty the attacker must SURPASS (tie = attack fails).
FORJA.Combat.Defensa.BlocarReaccioDesc: No roll; you must beat (not just match) basic defense. If the attack hits, it adds the chosen means' skill to damage reduction (up to doubling it).
FORJA.Curacio.PrimersAuxilisDesc: Difficulty 1 (requires medicine 1+, or engineering/jury-rigging for mechanoids). On success, clears stunned/dazed/bleeding.
FORJA.Curacio.TractamentMedicDesc: Difficulty 2 (requires medicine 2+, or engineering/jury-rig for mechanoids). On a success, clears unconscious/incapacitated.
FORJA.Curacio.AssistenciaTecnicaDesc: Technical assistance: difficulty = 2 + the points you declare to repair. On a success, exactly these points are recovered (no need to wait for rest). Doing it with Jury-Rig instead of Engineering breaks the mechanoid's wound auto-repair until a successful Engineering repair.
FORJA.Curacio.DescansBloquejat: {nom} cannot recover on their own by resting (needs medical treatment).
FORJA.Assistent.IntroIdentitat: Start by giving the character a name and concept. The rest of the sheet details can be completed later.
FORJA.Assistent.IntroAtributs: Distribute points among the six primary attributes (0–5). Each level has a fixed cost, indicated below, or choose a quick distribution and adjust it later.
FORJA.Assistent.IntroCos: Choose the species and define the character's size and constitution.
FORJA.Assistent.IntroHabilitats: Assign levels to skills (0–10). The cost shown is the cumulative cost from zero to the current level, or choose a quick package and adjust it later.
FORJA.Assistent.NotaPaquets: You can combine several packages: each only fills basic skills still at 0.
FORJA.Assistent.IntroTrets: Add positive or negative traits from the manual. Incompatibilities are checked automatically in the final summary.
FORJA.Assistent.IntroEquipament: Optional: give the character initial equipment. This step can be skipped and added later from the sheet.
FORJA.Assistent.IntroResum: Review the total cost and consistency warnings before starting to play.
FORJA.Assistent.SenseAvisos: No warnings: creation is consistent with the budget and rules.
FORJA.Sobrenatural.PuntsExtraNota: Extending duration or adding targets/areas (other uses from the manual) are resolved narratively — the balance cost is the same per point.
FORJA.Sobrenatural.AvisRitual: Ritual: add here the dice/difficulty for resonance, assistants, and materials or sacrifices the GM decides (Dice mod. / Diff mod., above).
FORJA.Sobrenatural.ResistirIntro: {actor} manifests an effect on {objectiu}. Wish to resist?
FORJA.Sobrenatural.DesferIntro: Once the active effect is analyzed (game time, at GM's discretion), a roll is required that SURPASSES the milestones with which it was originally manifested. If the exact number is unknown, the GM informs it.
FORJA.Sobrenatural.DesferLabelPlaceholde: e.g. Fire barrier from the warlock
FORJA.Sobrenatural.PifiaDesferAvis: A botch when undoing a powerful effect can have very unpleasant consequences (at GM's discretion — the manual provides no formula).
FORJA.Sobrenatural.AvisEquilibriNegatiu: Was already in negative balance before manifesting: the GM may apply some additional negative effect (at discretion).
FORJA.Sobrenatural.OferirControlText: {nom} has countered the effect "{efecte}" and deflected it. Instead of letting it dissipate, {nom} can attempt to take control of it: the effect will become contested, both gifted will enter concentration (no reactions, +1 die) and milestones will accumulate turn by turn until one wins or yields. Want to attempt it?
FORJA.Sobrenatural.ControlGuanyat: {nom} has taken control of the effect "{efecte}" — the GM decides how it manifests or is directed now.
FORJA.Sobrenatural.DisputaEspera: Waiting for your turn to declare to continue or yield.
FORJA.Avis.MesDunDo: This character has traits from more than one supernatural gift ({dons}): gifts are mutually exclusive.
FORJA.Avis.EfecteDoIncorrecte: The effect "{nom}" is from {do}, a different gift than yours: only gifted of a certain type can use it.
FORJA.Construccio.Intro: Choose parameters to build a custom effect. Cost, difficulty, and latency are recalculated live. Core: only the most frequent categories (Damage, Healing, Protection, States, Skills) — the rest (Alteration, Transformation, Translocation, Mentals, Telekinesis, Replication, Summoning...) are not here yet.
FORJA.Construccio.IntroArtefacte: Choose parameters to design a custom artifact (same engine as effects, plus artifact parameters). Upon creation, it starts as a first prototype: fragile until the GM considers it passed.
FORJA.Progressio.AvisRecerca: Once the target is defined with the builder, remember the GM must approve the intention and in-game time must be invested in research before attempting to manifest it (manual, ch. 5) — here only the XP cost is calculated and the test roll is resolved.
FORJA.Progressio.TextFallada: The roll did not surpass the difficulty. According to the manual, you must pay 2 additional XP and invest another week of research before trying again. Want to pay the penalty and try again?
FORJA.Combat.ForaDeCombat: {nom} is out of combat (unconscious or incapacitated): cannot act.
FORJA.Combat.DefensorForaDeCombat: The defender is out of combat: basic defense 1 and no active defense.
FORJA.Combat.ConcentrarDesc: +1 die to this action's roll, but you won't be able to react until you resolve it. If you take damage, you lose concentration.
FORJA.Combat.ConcentracioAtordit: {nom} has taken more damage than their FOR: they become stunned and the action they were concentrating on fails (it must be declared again).
FORJA.Combat.EgidaReactivaAlTick: The aegis becomes effective again at tick {tick} of the clock.
FORJA.Combat.EgidaReactivacioManual: Outside active time: reactivate the aegis by hand once the time has passed (it's a free action).
FORJA.Combat.MarcadorDesc: Current tick of the active-time marker
FORJA.Dice.ConcentratEstatDesc: Concentration declared: +1 die on this roll (consumed when rolled).
FORJA.Socket.SenseDJ: No GM is connected: the change cannot be applied to a document you don't own.
FORJA.Socket.TempsEsgotat: The GM did not respond in time; the change may not have been applied.
FORJA.Socket.Error: The GM could not apply the change: {error}
FORJA.Confirmar.EliminarText: Are you sure you want to delete "{nom}"? This action cannot be undone.
FORJA.AccionsComplexes.Intro: For tasks too difficult to resolve in a single roll: every time the dedicated time is doubled, the difficulty is halved (rounding up), until it becomes manageable. The GM always has the final word on whether time is available to reach a specific tier.
FORJA.AccionsComplexes.NotaExcedent: If the final roll has surplus, it must be divided by the same divisor of the chosen tier before interpreting it.
